properties.name: Kunkel Lake
properties.source: Indiana DNR depth map, 2013 scanned map (survey 2013-09-05, ciBioBase colour map) — lines traced from the colour bands
properties.review_notes: DNR scanned depth map 2013-09-05 (no embedded coordinates). Depths read from the map's colour legend (2–13 ft) and drawn as 1-ft lines 3–12 ft; max 13 ft is the legend maximum. Placed by matching roads and buildings on the scan's photo background to current satellite imagery (12 landmark matches, ~1 m residual). Satellite check: 0% of lines 5 ft and deeper off water; 0.4% of all line points off water (true-colour + NAIP near-infrared). The basic brightness check is not usable here (turbid water). The small island shown on the 2013 map is now joined to the east shore by a beach; 1.6% of line length that crossed that present-day land was removed.

properties.source: Indiana Dept. of Conservation, Division of Fish and Game 1924 depth-contour map (surveyed by W. M. Tucker, Indiana University; Map Collection, Indiana Division, Indiana State Library)
properties.review_notes: Hand-traced from the 1924 map (5-ft depth curves), shoreline fit to osm:relation/11643177. Standard strict.py (Esri imagery): 100% inside outline, 0.8% of line points off water (only short bits of the 5-ft line hugging the modern north shore; 0% of 10-35 ft lines), overlay check/syracuse-lake-kosciusko_strict_h.png. Scale bar 1500 ft = 742 px; shoreline ICP fit rms 5.8 m. 76 of 106 line pieces assigned from map labels (hand + sandwich propagation); in the unlabelled 15-20 ft middle of the east half, curve shapes between drawn lines are interpolated (straight runs there are approximate), and a small 10-ft shoal in that area is not drawn.

properties.name: Lake James
properties.source: Indiana Dept. of Conservation, Division of Fish and Game 1923 depth-contour map (surveyed by W. M. Tucker, Indiana University; Map Collection, Indiana Division, Indiana State Library)
properties.review_notes: Hand-traced from the 1923 map (5-ft depth curves), shoreline fit to osm:relation/13103696. Standard strict.py (Esri imagery): 100% inside outline, 0.6% of line points off water (deep lines 0.2%; mostly short 5-ft bits at the modern shoreline), overlay check/lake-james-steuben_strict_h10f.png. Scan back-overlay: every drawn line lies on a scan line read at that depth (h54/jm10f_back_*.jpg). Map: 1923 IDC Lake James blueprint (Tucker), max 86 ft, 5-ft interval; scale ~3.2 ft/px, shoreline ICP fit rms 16.7 m. Depths matched piece by piece from printed map labels plus line counting between labelled lines (343 of 771 significant line pieces); lines whose depth could not be read (parts of Uncle Toms Flat, the north-pocket and channel walls, the narrows, Bowles Bay and several shallow stacks) are left undrawn, so curves have gaps. Deepest drawn curve 85 ft. Snow Lake (same map) not included.
